kind: Engineering scope mapping, not independent QA test plan or result

rows.title: Reproducible setup
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Lock/direct-dependency distinction, environment identity and reproducible setup; clean-install QA remains pending.

rows.title: Inputs validated
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Validate explicit plans/URLs/IDs and actionable CLI errors. Old --project flags, exact three-line errors and test filenames belong to the retired CLI.

rows.title: One invocation, plus separable entry points
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Separable stages remain: decide, collect/resume/add/refresh, then offline agent skill. The default one-command Capture+Prepare build is retired.

rows.title: Paths stay inside outputs, no overwrite
rows.current_and_retired_binding: New review/collection/package paths, confined saved references, no silent overwrite and preservation of prior attempts; arbitrary user-supplied output path is explicit, not old project-slug routing.

rows.title: Scope, redirects, limits
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Explicit planned scope, sequential default5s pacing, refusals/challenges and no automatic retries remain. Custom pre-dispatch per-hop scope/five-hop/CDP cancellation machinery is retired; redirects/resources are extra browser traffic.

rows.title: Failures visible
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Failures, interruption, progress and cleanup must remain visible. Current resume reuses a collection and immutable attempts; old no-resume/always-new-run rule and old exit mapping are retired.

rows.title: Route set + identity rule
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Bounded explicit sitemap/default discovery, stable URL IDs, dedup and provenance remain. Old tracking-query stripping/routes.json identity binding is not the DECIDE normalize rule.

rows.title: Every route accounted per stream
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Each approved checklist item is accounted for; HTML and REST are separately selected. Mandatory per-route REST mapping/raw-v2 pages[] accounting belongs to the old whole-site design.

rows.title: HTML untouched
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Rendered Crawl4AI HTML is saved as UTF-8 at the declared boundary with hashes, without pretending it is original compressed wire bytes.

rows.title: Block pages never captured
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Do not call refusals/challenge documents or empty/failed capture successful content; detector is heuristic, not comprehensive access certification.

rows.title: REST + SEO survive
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Complete selected REST entity bytes, all returned fields and hashes survive; malformed mandatory identities fail. Old object derivatives/route mapping/mandatory SEO inventory are retired. No production four-field filter is injected.

rows.title: Pagination + non-REST routes
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Only explicitly approved pagination follows advertised pages within max_pages; short-page anomalies/duplicates/count gaps stay explicit. Mandatory REST mapping of every HTML route is retired.

rows.title: Site-level inventory retained
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Save recon source evidence/types/counts and collection status. Whole-site robots/every-sitemap/six-collection rest/index layout is retired; no automatic collection expansion.

rows.title: REST-empty / rendered-present
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Present-empty REST content remains empty and cannot erase substantive HTML. Dated complementary observations retained; no Thrive/plugin cause asserted.

rows.title: Media inventory with provenance
rows.current_and_retired_binding: No automatic media inventory/HEAD sweep/download. Saved page image references and explicit gaps remain available; this does not close historical media coverage defects.

rows.title: Manifest + stage log explain the run
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Checklist/result/attempt records, runtime, planned timing and separate cleanup explain collection. Old manifest/stage-log/native-ID and exact supervisor counters are retired bindings.

rows.title: Typed absences
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Pending/completed/failed items and explicit partial/stop reasons preserve losses. Old raw-v2 absence enums and requirement to map every site route are retired.

rows.title: Authored evidence distinct
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Authored screenshot stream/manifest is not a current feature requirement. Agent-authored brief/interpretation is still distinguished from captured facts.

rows.title: Raw untouched by Prepare
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Prepare is offline and source collections remain unchanged; new derived package construction is allowed.

rows.title: Invalid raw fails visibly
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Invalid completed references/hashes refuse preparation before output. Old F-10/raw-v2 version checks, pack.json and exit3 are retired; current helper refusal is exit2.

rows.title: Provenance on every derived record
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Prepared page IDs, URLs, capture dates, raw/metadata/derived hashes and CSS locators trace to saved evidence; authoring/context sources are indexed.

rows.title: Labels distinguishable
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Separate observed source facts, agent interpretation and unknown/absent information; a helper hint is not a final reviewed classification.

rows.title: Sitemap/IA + content inventory
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Numbered JSON/Markdown candidate inventory and prepared selected sample remain. Mandatory whole-site site_map/content_inventory snapshots are retired.

rows.title: Disagreements visible
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Expose observed cross-source differences without fabricating a winner. Mandatory disagreements.json/F-06 three-conflict schema belongs to the retired pack.

rows.title: SEO preserved
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Preserve returned SEO fields in raw selected REST and avoid invention. Automatic full derived SEO inventory/Yoast certification is outside current demonstrated skill scope.

rows.title: Forms/embeds honest
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Forms/embeds are observed markup only; agent source inspection records unavailable child content, no booking/form testing or automatic iframe fetch. Exact old F-07 output schema is retired.

rows.title: Design observed, not prescribed
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Observed facts and authored design implications must be distinguishable. Agent architect brief may state labeled implications; old automatic design JSON/rule schema is retired.

rows.title: Media classes preserve everything
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Automatic media classes/rules and full media_classification.json are retired; no authority to delete/promote source data.

rows.title: Loss surfaced
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Missing/failed capture and useful-content gaps remain explicit in checklist/GAPS_AND_REQUESTS. Old loss_ledger/pack.json/F-12 exact-two-loss binding is historical.

rows.title: Confidence ≠ authority
rows.current_and_retired_binding: No source/package deletion, destructive cleanup, URL promotion or overwrite based on confidence; preserve originals and only write separately derived material.

rows.title: Twins agree
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Inventory JSON and readable listing represent the same review version. Automatically generated twins for every Data Pack JSON are retired; briefs are agent authored.

rows.title: Prepare reproducible
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Hashes and exact preserved content support repeatable extraction; new derived paths preserve older packages. Bitwise reproducibility of agent interpretation and old deterministic pack schema is not promised.

rows.title: Entry brief points to real inventory
rows.current_and_retired_binding: ARCHITECT_BRIEF/GAPS/source index point to real prepared/evidence files. SITE_RECON_BRIEF/pack.json count schema is retired.

rows.title: Pack answers B7
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Useful architect positioning/offer/content/CTA implications plus gaps for the selected sample remain. Full frozen B7 Data Pack schema is not automatically a current feature.

rows.title: Cold-read without live access
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Offline consumer usefulness/cold-read remains relevant; original fresh-Fable twelve-B7/certificate binding is preserved history. Executor and QA Lead must decide current applicability, not Cody.

rows.title: Drill-down works
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Source drill-down resolves URL/date/raw hash/metadata/CSS boundaries; any QA spot-check selection is the independent Executor’s work.

rows.title: Portable delivery unit
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Review handoff must be self-contained, with readable governing inputs and reproducible fixture/reference restoration. Original isolated pack/raw portability schema is retired.

rows.title: Honest completeness
rows.current_and_retired_binding: State selected-scope completion separately from useful-content/child-content completeness and cleanup. Counts advertised are not content captured; missing data cannot become complete.

rows.title: Full chain on fixture site
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Current stages work together and have saved selected-flow/local proof. Old default E1 full Capture+Prepare fixture pipeline is retired; no mandatory new feature test framework.

rows.title: Real target reproducible
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Old E2 two full-site runs/hour separation is not a current obligation/allocation. Existing bounded live evidence is preserved; new live QA requires Tony’s explicit scope.

rows.title: Certified behavior stays green
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Working current collector/DECIDE/skill behavior must not regress. Old certified --project/raw-v2/output controller suite is history; current focused tests are engineering claims, not QA certification.

rows.title: Limits recorded
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Current planned-call/time/post-receipt byte limits and partial outcomes remain. Exact aggregate supervisor, redirect-hop request budgets and old --limit route ceiling are retired.

rows.title: Untrusted input contained
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Untrusted captures are data; confine authored references, preserve raw bytes, strip scripts/styles from derived content, never execute embedded instructions. Presentation/viewer adversarial breadth remains for independent review, not a new PASS claim.

rows.title: No secrets leak
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Do not expose private credentials/cookies/authorization; evidence/ZIP hygiene remains. Full historical sentinel/negative-control certification is not claimed by current focused tests; QA Lead binds any applicable check.

rows.title: Auditable, resumable
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Factual recovery/session/journal/checkpoints and durable collector checklist support resume. Retired C1–E2 task ordering is not the current schedule.

rows.title: Ledger complete
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Keep all48 canonical ledger rows/status/history; current scope mapping and engineering evidence supplement them. Independent result fields remain NOT RUN.

rows.title: Instructions match tool
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Current entry documentation matches the real CLI/agent workflow; hardcoded saved-input requirements are packaged/documented. Clean-clone operator/independent QA checks remain pending.

rows.title: Candidate and evidence agree
rows.current_and_retired_binding: Exact source including untracked files binds engineering evidence; Tony’s future actual commit binds QA. Independent verdict/cleanup/review/merge/closeout decisions remain pending, not fabricated.
